name: Pending Settlement 2 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is pending settlement, that is, pending delivery or receipt of the financial instrument. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is still possible.

AWMO.name: Awaiting Money
AWMO.definition: Securities have been delivered, but the settlement amount has not been received from the counterparty.

CAIS.name: Awaiting Securities
CAIS.definition: Awaiting securities from corporate action issue or other procedures, for example, conversion, dematerialisation, exchange, registration, stamping, splitting, etc.

REFU.name: Instruction Refused Or Not Recognised
REFU.definition: Instruction that has been refused or not recognised, and is represented automatically.

AWSH.name: Awaiting Shares From Counterparty
AWSH.definition: Securities have not yet been received from the counterparty.

PHSE.name: Physical Delivery Delay
PHSE.definition: Settlement is physical and securities are being delivered.

TAMM.name: Trade Amended In Market
TAMM.definition: Trade is being amended in the market.

DOCY.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From You
DOCY.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from you.

DOCC.name: Awaiting Documents Or Endorsements From Counterparty
DOCC.definition: Awaiting documents or endorsements from the counterparty.

BLOC.name: Account Blocked
BLOC.definition: Your account is blocked, no instruction can settle over the account.

CHAS.name: Enquiry Sent
CHAS.definition: Chaser/enquiry sent to the agent or depository.

NEWI.name: New Issues
NEWI.definition: Securities are new issues and are not yet available/tradable.

CLAC.name: Counterparty Insufficient Securities
CLAC.definition: Insufficient deliverable securities in the counterparty's account, or counterparty does not hold the securities.

MUNO.name: Multiple Settlement Amount
MUNO.definition: Securities quantity is not a multiple of an existing settlement amount lot for the instructed financial instrument.

GLOB.name: Global Form Securities
GLOB.definition: Settlement cannot be executed as securities are in global form.

PREA.name: Preadvice Instructed
PREA.definition: Your instruction is a preadvice, that is, matching only.

GUAD.name: Guaranteed Delivery Indicator Difference
GUAD.definition: Guaranteed delivery indicator differs in the counterparty's instruction.

NMAS.name: No Matching Required
NMAS.definition: Instruction has not been matched because the matching process is not required.

CMON.name: Counterparty Insufficient Money
CMON.definition: Insufficient money in the counterparty's account.

YCOL.name: Collateral Shortage
YCOL.definition: Not enough collateral in your account to execute the transaction.

COLL.name: Securities Pledged As Collateral
COLL.definition: Securities are not deliverable as they are pledged as collateral.

DEPO.name: Refused Deposit For Issue Of Depositary Receipts
DEPO.definition: Deposit of shares for the issuing of depositary receipts has been refused. The allotment for depositary receipts granted by the issuer is exceeded by the transaction.

FLIM.name: Maximum Foreign Limit Reached
FLIM.definition: Insufficient deliverable securities in your account because the maximum foreign limit has been reached.

INCA.name: Income Adjustement Required
INCA.definition: Securities require income adjustment, for example, dividend or interest.

LINK.name: Pending Linked Instruction
LINK.definition: Your instruction is pending settlement because the instruction linked to it is pending.

FUTU.name: Awaiting Settlement Date
FUTU.definition: Instruction is awaiting the settlement date, and no settlement problems have been reported.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient deliverable securities in your account.

LALO.name: Securities Loaned Out
LALO.definition: Insufficient deliverable securities in your account because securities are loaned out.

NCON.name: Confirmation Not Received
NCON.definition: Settlement confirmation has not been received.

REFS.name: Not In Good Order
REFS.definition: Delivery/receipt has been refused because the physical securities are not in good order.

SDUT.name: Lack Of Stamp Duty Information
SDUT.definition: Instruction is pending as stamp duty information is missing.

BATC.name: Processing Batch Difference
BATC.definition: Processing batch differs in the counterparty's instruction, for example, day time/real time versus overnight.

CYCL.name: Awaiting Next Settlement Cycle
CYCL.definition: Instruction is confirmed in the local market or is ready for settlement, awaiting the next settlement cycle.

SBLO.name: Securities Blocked
SBLO.definition: Settlement is pending. The securities are blocked due to, for example, a corporate action event, re-alignment.

CPEC.name: Counterparty In Receivership
CPEC.definition: Counterparty is in receivership, that is, the form of bankruptcy where a court appointed person, the receiver, manages the affairs of the business.

MINO.name: Minimum Settlement Amount
MINO.definition: Securities amount is lower than the minimum existing settlement amount for the instructed financial instrument.

PCAP.name: Pending CAP
PCAP.definition: Payment is pending, and does not settle because the actual use of the risk management limit on the counterpart (bilateral limit) prevents settlement.
